notes:
Background: Mid-market product analytics SaaS (product search + in-app help). Currently ~300 engineers + product. Primary contact: VP Product (Ethan Wade).

Recent posture: started with competitor API (OpenAI) for quick shipping; now evaluating Redwood to reduce per-token cost and gain deterministic performance + dedicated pools. Interested in Hosted API first (fast test) and then Dedicated for production traffic + VPC.

POC ask: migrate 3 critical flows with minimal prompt changes — in-app chat bot (support + product guidance), embeddings for semantic search, and a reranking pipeline for recommendations. Key non-functional reqs: p95 latency <= 200ms for chat 1-2 turn flows, throughput steady-state ~120 req/s, embeddings bulk backfill ~500k vectors/month.

Quotes from calls: "We need output parity — same answers or better, otherwise product risk." — Ethan Wade.

Security: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML integration mandatory, KMS for at-rest keys, audit logs for model calls, US data residency preferred. Legal wants MSA review after pricing agreed.

POC impressions: Hosted API quick to onboard; saw ~10-12% lower token cost in Hosted baseline than current vendor. Some prompt regressions in edge cases (product-version info and code snippets). Redwood team offered regression eval harness and compatibility shim to match tokenization/stop sequences.

Sticking points: (1) Need clear rollback/fallback policy during rollout (they want automatic fallback to previous model/vendor). (2) Pricing for Dedicated reserved capacity needs to beat long-term blended cost target. (3) Security review timeline — KMS + VPC network diagrams waiting on infra team.

Internal champions: Head of Engineering (Rachel Kim) and Dir. of AI (Omar Ali).

AE notes: good momentum after demo 2024-11-21. Finance segnments cost sensitivity but willing to commit if we demonstrate prompt parity and provide a short SLA for critical routes.

use_case_summary: Three-phase migration: (1) quick Hosted API proof-of-concept to validate model outputs and latency; (2) run regression harness to achieve prompt parity (compat layer + stop/tokenization tuning); (3) transition critical routes to Dedicated with VPC and reserved capacity to meet cost and latency SLOs.
poc_details: Scope: chat bot (support + product guidance), embeddings for doc search, reranking for top-N personalization. Endpoints tested: /v1/chat/completions (compat shim), /v1/embeddings, custom rerank endpoint. Validation criteria: semantic similarity A/B, NDCG for search, human review of 200 sample conversations. Metrics captured: token cost delta vs current vendor, p50/p95 latency, failure modes. Current status: hosted POC shows 88% parity on sample prompts; 7 prompts flagged for tuning; SE recommended prompt templates + stop-sequence alignment. Redwood provided eval harness and suggested quantization profile for Dedicated. Expect dedicated capacity sizing review week of 2024-12-16.
pricing_notes: Initial Hosted credits used for POC. Pricing meeting 2024-12-09 covered two Dedicated options: (A) 6-month small reserved pool — lower entry price, higher per-token; (B) 12-month medium reserved pool — better unit economics, requires finance approval. Target: blended cost <= current vendor by 10% over 12 months. Finance asked for clear overage and burst policies. Requested formal quote + MSA by 2024-12-20.
